# Daily Briefing — Tuesday 7 July

Yesterday was a rest day with decent movement — 7,906 steps and 2,443 kcal burned naturally, which is a solid active recovery baseline. Sleep at 5.5 hours is the main concern here; that's meaningfully short and will have downstream effects today.

Your HRV at 94ms sits below your 101-119ms baseline, almost certainly reflecting that sleep deficit. Resting HR of 49bpm looks great, and stress at 30/100 is calm — so this isn't burnout, just under-recovered. Keep today's session but reduce intensity if it's anything hard. An easy aerobic run or steady effort is fine; save the quality work for when you've slept properly.

Priority tonight: get to bed earlier and protect 7-8 hours. With 51 days to Chester, consistent sleep will move your HRV back into baseline faster than any supplement. Hit your 175g protein today to support recovery while you're in this slight deficit.
